description: This file contains utility functions for collating and converting data samples into batches suitable for processing within PyTorch DataLoader. It includes `default_collate`, various specific collate functions for tensors and numpy arrays, and conversions for common data types, facilitating batch creation and preprocessing.

methods.name: default_convert(data)
methods.description: Converts NumPy arrays and nested data structures into PyTorch tensors, preserving other data types. Used as part of collation process to handle individual data points.

methods.name: collate( batch, *, collate_fn_map: dict[type | tuple[type, ...], Callable] | None = None, )
methods.description: General-purpose function to combine a list of samples into a batch, handling various data types and structures including tensors, numpy arrays, mappings, and sequences. Supports custom collate functions via `collate_fn_map`.

methods.name: collate_tensor_fn( batch, *, collate_fn_map: dict[type | tuple[type, ...], Callable] | None = None, )
methods.description: Collates a batch of tensors, stacking them into a batched tensor, with support for nested and sparse tensors, and sharing memory in worker processes.

methods.name: collate_numpy_array_fn( batch, *, collate_fn_map: dict[type | tuple[type, ...], Callable] | None = None, )
methods.description: Converts a batch of numpy arrays into a batch of torch tensors, raises error if the array contains strings or objects.

methods.name: collate_numpy_scalar_fn( batch, *, collate_fn_map: dict[type | tuple[type, ...], Callable] | None = None, )
methods.description: Converts a batch of numpy scalar values into a torch tensor.

methods.name: collate_float_fn( batch, *, collate_fn_map: dict[type | tuple[type, ...], Callable] | None = None, )
methods.description: Converts a batch of float values into a torch float64 tensor.

methods.name: collate_int_fn( batch, *, collate_fn_map: dict[type | tuple[type, ...], Callable] | None = None, )
methods.description: Converts a batch of int values into a torch tensor.

methods.name: collate_str_fn( batch, *, collate_fn_map: dict[type | tuple[type, ...], Callable] | None = None, )
methods.description: Returns the batch of string or bytes data unchanged.

methods.name: default_collate(batch)
methods.description: Default function to collate a batch of data samples into a batched tensor or other suitable structure, handling various primitive types, containers, and nested structures.
